bug_semantics: conflux_send_switch_command() encodes a RELAY_COMMAND_CONFLUX_SWITCH cell and calls relay_send_command_from_edge() without checking the return. That helper packages the cell onto the circuit queue and, on failure, logs, calls circuit_mark_for_close(), and returns -1. Closing a conflux leg runs conflux_circuit_has_closed() -> cfx_del_leg(), which NULLs cfx->curr_leg when it matches the closing leg and tor_free()s the leg object. conflux_decide_circ_for_send() has already swapped cfx->curr_leg to the new hop and, treating the SWITCH send as success, writes cfx->curr_leg->last_seq_sent; after the free/NULL that store is a NULL write after free and crashes. CWE-252 (unchecked return) is the direct defect; the crash is TROVE-2026-017 / bug 41263.
flaw_origin: The ignored SWITCH send was first written in 8b185b2ac3d8240fe5f8cda41699ab10d1167844 (Prop#329 Cells: Building and parsing parsing conflux commands, David Goulet / Mike Perry, 2023-02-01 / committed 2023-04-06). That commit added src/core/or/conflux_cell.c with conflux_send_switch_command() at lines 315-354 calling relay_send_command_from_edge() unchecked at 339-343 and 345-348, while the same file checked the identical helper for CONFLUX_LINK / LINKED / LINKED_ACK. Immediate parent 45432175fe6b0929274d6db94aa50aab9a39b452 has no conflux_cell.c and no SWITCH send. The later send-path caller and close-path cfx_del_leg() in the same Prop#329 series complete the crash, but they did not write the unchecked call; later payload-size and seq-overflow edits also left that call unchecked until the 2026 fix.

Complete crash path in the same Prop#329 series: e0881a669a84d016ea108a5604f25bbcb45a7705 src/core/or/conflux.c:592-593 ignores conflux_send_switch_command() then writes cfx->curr_leg->last_seq_sent; 336a24754d117b46793ce6824e35ff6b7962bf9d adds cfx_del_leg() (NULLs curr_leg and tor_free(leg) when the closing circuit is current) and wires circuit_mark_for_close_ to conflux_circuit_has_closed(). 8b185b2 is an ancestor of both.

ba6db4ce97c3f654ee33b0abeb0f12ba6acc96af (2025-10-30) made the caller abort when conflux_send_switch_command() returns false, but the send helper still returned true on relay_send_command_from_edge() failure, so the curr_leg write still ran after cfx_del_leg().
